text:
Lina: opened PR #908 to add SDK examples for JS/Go and a short migration note for Dedicated. Vercel preview shows anchor links jumping to top sometimes and one code block loses YAML highlighting :confused:
Omar: can you paste the preview link? I can repro locally if needed
Lina: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/deployments/2468 — in the build logs I see warnings about truncated anchors and a note about 'toc' plugin version mismatch
Priya: we recently bumped mkdocs-toc plugin in main, but previews still use the cached image. ci-bot usually mentions it
ci-bot: Deployment 2468 finished: succeeded with warnings. Warning: mkdocs-plugin-toc v0.2.5 vs site config expecting v0.3.0. Cached runner: redwood/doc-preview:20260402.
Omar: that aligns — older toc handles anchor ids differently which explains the jump. For the YAML highlight, Vercel's markdown renderer missed the language tag; PR uses ```yaml but preview shows plain. Could be pandoc/markdown extension mismatch
Lina: I updated the PR to include explicit anchor ids for the troublesome headings and added fenced block lang hints: ```yaml:title=config.yaml
Priya: nice. Also left a note to add a one-liner to the JS example about setting REDWOOD_API_URL when testing against Dedicated. We should avoid long runtime notes in the snippet
Ava: who is going to review? I'm on calls until 4pm PT. If previews are green I'd be happy to do a quick pass afterwards
Omar: I can do the technical review (examples & config). Priya can check wording and migration checklist. If both approve we can merge in the end-of-day merge slot at 5:30 PT
Lina: pushed fixes for anchors & codeblocks. Also added a short local preview tip in the PR description: "If you see anchor jumps, run `mkdocs serve` with no base_url, or build static html and serve via `python -m http.server` to mimic preview server"
ci-bot: Rebuild triggered for PR #908 by Lina. Deployment 2469 started.
Omar: 2469 logs look clean, no warnings about toc. Preview: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/deployments/2469 — anchors behaving on my end :+1:
Priya: reviewing now, will check migration checklist and any cross-links. Small nit: change 'Dedicated' -> 'Redwood Dedicated' for clarity. Leaving that comment now
Ava: approved wording change. Approving after tiny tweak
Omar: technical LGTM. I verified the Go example compiles with go1.20 (added a short mention in the snippet header)
Lina: thanks all! I'll merge at 5:30 PT unless anyone flags new issues. Opening follow-up issue to add a CI preflight that detects plugin mismatches for preview runners (so we don't get this cached-image drift)
Priya: +1 for the CI preflight. Also add a note in the docs contributor guide about anchoring headings to avoid renderer differences
Lina: filed issue #314 for the preflight and #315 for contributor guide wording. Merging at 5:30.
